The problem

Studios deserve
better than this

You started a studio to help people move, not to wrestle with software. But right now you're paying for a bloated booking platform and a separate website builder and an email tool. Or worse — managing it all through Instagram DMs and a spreadsheet.

01

Enterprise pricing, micro-studio budget

Mindbody starts at £110+/month with hidden fees, long contracts, and 3.5% on every transaction. Built for chains, priced for chains.

02

Two tools duct-taped together

A Squarespace site with a booking widget embedded. Two logins, two subscriptions, zero integration. Your brand feels like an afterthought.

03

Booking tools with no web presence

Most studio software gives you a scheduling form, not a website. Your clients see a functional page, not a brand they connect with.
